title: Surviving the London Blitz Blackout
hook: Lighting a cigarette outside could get you arrested.

scenes.text: During the London Blitz, every single city street was plunged into pitch-black darkness by order of the government.
scenes.imagePrompt: 1940s London high street under total midnight blackout with dark silhouette of Big Ben and searchlight beams crisscrossing the cloudy sky. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: During the London Blitz, every single city street was plunged into pitch-black darkness by order of the government.

scenes.text: Wardens patrolled neighborhoods shouting 'Put that light out!' if even a crack of candlelight escaped heavy blackout curtains.
scenes.imagePrompt: Row of Victorian brick terraced houses at night with thick black cloth drawn tight across glowing window frames. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Wardens patrolled neighborhoods shouting 'Put that light out!' if even a crack of candlelight escaped heavy blackout curtains.

scenes.text: Streetlights were turned off, and cars drove with metal slotted hoods over their headlamps that emitted only faint downwards glows.
scenes.imagePrompt: 1940s vintage black automobile parked by a cobblestone curb with hooded slotted headlights casting dim beams onto wet asphalt. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Streetlights were turned off, and cars drove with metal slotted hoods over their headlamps that emitted only faint downwards glows.

scenes.text: Walking home was treacherous: thousands tripped into bomb craters, bumped into lampposts, or accidentally fell into the Thames river.
scenes.imagePrompt: Misty Thames riverbank with cast-iron railings and white stripes painted on tree trunks to guide night walkers. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Walking home was treacherous: thousands tripped into bomb craters, bumped into lampposts, or accidentally fell into the Thames river.

scenes.text: To avoid nighttime car crashes, city councils painted curbs, lamp posts, and even cow tails with reflective white stripes.
